payload.title: Reject non-Name module rebindings before asserting declaration, Reference or direct-base truth
payload.summary: P1 RI correctness, source-authenticated false positive. Current modules.declarations lookup, references.declarations.bindings._module_bindings and classes.bases._bindings omit names stored in MatchAs, MatchStar, MatchMapping.rest and ExceptHandler.name. With real observed target.py defining f followed by case f or except ValueError as f, lookup and final f() Reference remain RESOLVED; local and imported class bases also remain RESOLVED. Ordinary f=0 is correctly ambiguous. Twelve independently authored function/class fixtures include eight defective variants, two valid controls and two assignment negatives. No runtime source executed, forged identities or native edit-authority bypass claimed.
payload.benefit: Owner context/python bounded static binding semantics. Preserve direct source-syntax selection independently of binding resolution. Add independent real-observation regressions for pattern name/star/mapping-rest and exception aliases, local/direct-module/imported targets, and before/after child evaluation where relevant. Nonpositive or unsupported output must replace false established relations; no runtime execution required. Reuse existing _scope_bindings string-name recognition only where scope/traversal semantics actually match; do not create a general Python evaluator. Cover unrelated names, nested local scopes that must not shadow module names, ordinary assignment/delete, decorated/dynamic/wildcard and valid unchanged imports, plus native source_relationships/map fact composition. Preserve resource identities, ordering, unsupported distinctions, exact-source admission and source-selection behavior. Run focused/static and full100% protected gate on final source/test tree. Maintenance-agent implementation suitable with this frozen independently specified fixture matrix.
payload.uncertainty: One shared correctness family across three actual owners, not three duplicate stories. Native ContextTools._reference_analysis/_relationships and optional map preparation consume these facts; reachability is proven by source, no model invocation/effectiveness or observed historical engineering harm established. Complete guard repair must inspect scope and order contracts; audit records pending repair instead of silently broadening binding semantics during documentation review. Preserve frozen historical sources; direct-base historical8927 has the same local guard limitation and is superseded for target lookup.
